notes: v1.0.32 — Follow-up to the critical update fix (v1.0.31): the direct-asset url fallback is now restricted to packaged installs only. Source/dev runs always update via the repository zip (codeload) and can no longer be hijacked by a direct exe link in the manifest url field; asset names also strip query strings/fragments. Same guarantees as v1.0.31: the manifest declares the asset as installer path + direct url, the Update button is disabled with a clear log when a packaged install has no asset (no silent repo-zip fallback), the download is logged at start and SHA-256-verified against the manifest (mismatch = file deleted + update cancelled loudly).
